title: Image generation and supporter logos get steadier
summary:
A maintenance day for image generation, supporter logos, Myceli materials, and Spore-to-Seed checks.

Flux GPU workers gained a configurable registration address to avoid a route that blocked some workers. Supporter logos switched to Z-Image after the previous model could reject requests made with a default publishable key.

The Myceli website, docs, pitch, one-pager, and dashboards were consolidated in the repository. DataRoom material moved out of the main site and into the docs, alongside separate pitch and one-pager sites.

Upgrade validation now checks recent users first and rotates through older users across the week. It also fetches fewer repositories per user, reducing GitHub API pressure.
